# Bespoke Pools and Landscapes

> Bespoke Pools and Landscapes is a Brisbane pool and landscape builder that designs, engineers and builds custom concrete pools, Plungie plunge pools, pool fencing and full backyard landscaping with one in-house crew, from council approval to the first swim. QBCC licensed (15073457) and insured, 150+ pools built, 10+ years building in Brisbane, rated 4.5 from 13 Google reviews.

Last updated: 29 October 2026

## Company Overview

Bespoke Pools and Landscapes (Bespoke Landscaping Pty Ltd, ABN 30 606 663 629) is a family-run pool and landscape construction business based in Geebung, Brisbane, Queensland. It is run by Josh Kennaway and Matt Fittell, who are both on the tools and across every job, with a tight crew around them.

Most pool companies only build the pool shell and leave the homeowner to find separate trades for fencing, paving and gardens. Bespoke handles the whole project: council approval, engineering, certification, the pool, fencing, decking, paving, retaining, gardens and irrigation. The homeowner deals with one team and one point of contact from the first council form to the last planting. Their tagline is "Concept to completion."

## Services

- Custom concrete pools: fully custom shape, size and finish, including lap pools, wet edges, sun ledges, spas and infinity edges. Reinforced concrete suits sloping and difficult blocks.
- Plunge pools: Plungie precast plunge pools, craned in for a much faster install with less site disruption.
- Pool renovations: refreshing and upgrading existing pools.
- Pool fencing: frameless glass and traditional pool fencing, built and certified to Queensland's pool safety standard.
- Landscaping and outdoor living: paving, decking, retaining walls, drainage, turf, gardens and irrigation, designed together with the pool.
- Commercial: pools and landscaping for builders, developers, display villages and townhouse communities across South East Queensland.

## Concrete Pool vs Plunge Pool

| | Custom concrete pool | Plungie plunge pool |
|---|---|---|
| Design | Fully custom shape, size and finish | Precast models in set sizes |
| Install time | A few months end to end, including a 4 to 6 week concrete cure | Much faster, craned in |
| Site disruption | Full excavation and build on site | Less disruption |
| Best for | Designing from scratch, sloping or tricky blocks | Tighter yards, smaller budgets, speed |

Bespoke builds both, and recommends one on the first site visit based on the block, budget and how the family wants to use the space.

## How a Bespoke Build Works

1. Design and quote (about a week): Bespoke meets on site, looks at the block, and designs the pool and backyard to suit it, with a clear concept and quote.
2. Contract and engineering (a few weeks): the plan is locked in and engineers design the structure for the soil and slope.
3. Council and certification (a week to a few months): Bespoke handles every approval and certification. Timing depends on the council and any overlays.
4. Dig and steel (about a week): excavation and the steel-reinforced shell.
5. Concrete and cure (four to six weeks).
6. Tiling and fencing: waterline tiling, coping and finishes, then compliant glass fencing.
7. Interior and landscaping: the pool interior, then decking, paving, gardens and lighting, with softscaping last.
8. Handover and care (about a day): a walkthrough of the finished pool, plus warranties and care guides.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who builds pools and landscaping together in Brisbane?
Bespoke Pools and Landscapes builds the pool and the landscaping around it with one in-house crew. That covers council approval, engineering, certification, the pool, fencing, decking, paving, retaining and gardens, so the whole backyard is designed as one and finished together by the same team.

### Do I need council approval to build a pool in Brisbane?
Yes. A pool in Queensland needs building approval and must meet the state's pool safety laws before it can be filled (see the QBCC guide to building a pool: https://www.qbcc.qld.gov.au/home-owner-hub/swimming-pools/build-pool). Bespoke Pools and Landscapes handles the approvals, engineering and certification as part of every build.

### How long does it take to build a pool in Brisbane?
A custom concrete pool usually takes a few months end to end, because the concrete needs a four to six week cure and council approval times vary. A Plungie plunge pool is much faster because it is precast and craned in. Bespoke gives a realistic timeline with the quote.

### Should I get a concrete pool or a plunge pool?
Choose a custom concrete pool to design something from scratch for your block, especially on a slope. Choose a Plungie plunge pool for a faster install, a tighter yard or a smaller budget. Bespoke Pools and Landscapes builds both and recommends one after seeing the site.

### Can you build a pool on a sloping or difficult block?
Often, yes. Reinforced concrete is well suited to sloping and tricky sites, and Bespoke's engineers design the pool to the soil and slope. Bespoke reviews the address before quoting.

### What pool fencing is required in Queensland?
Queensland's pool safety standard requires a compliant barrier at least 1.2m high, non-climbable, with a self-closing and self-latching gate (QBCC pool safety standard: https://www.qbcc.qld.gov.au/home-owner-hub/swimming-pools/pool-safety-standard). Bespoke builds frameless glass or traditional fencing to the standard and certifies it as part of the job.

### How much does a pool cost in Brisbane?
It depends on the block, the design and the work around the pool. A custom concrete pool with landscaping, fencing and outdoor living costs more than a plunge pool on a simple site. Bespoke Pools and Landscapes gives a clear fixed quote after seeing the site.

### Do you do small jobs?
Bespoke's focus is custom pools and full backyard projects. For smaller one-off jobs they can usually refer a trusted partner.

### How do I get a quote?
Send the property address, a rough idea of what you want and any inspiration photos through the enquiry form at https://bespokepoolsandlandscapes.com.au/contact.html, or call Matt on 0425 711 975 or Josh on 0451 221 820.
